source.paper: A Cosmic Miracle: A Remarkably Luminous Galaxy at z_spec = 14.44 Confirmed with JWST
source.authors: Rohan P. Naidu, Pascal A. Oesch et al.
source.facility: JWST / NIRSpec / NIRCam / COSMOS-Web / Mirage-or-Miracle Survey

lcdm_predictions.notes: Under standard Lambda-CDM initial perturbation spectrum (P(k) ~ k^{n_s} with n_s=0.965), dark matter halos massive enough to host an M_UV = -20.2 galaxy at z=14.44 are exponentially rare on the exponential tail of the Sheth-Tormen mass function. The required baryon conversion efficiency would exceed 100% of available gas in typical halos.

black_hole_universe_prediction.notes: Spin-torsion coupling in Einstein-Cartan cosmology produces a non-singular bounce with an enhanced primordial power spectrum on sub-horizon scales and primordial seed fluctuations. This accelerates early starburst ignition at t < 300 Myr.
